facts.title: Sunshine Salad Dressing
ingredients: ½ cup plain Greek yogurt (any % fat will do)
2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar or more lemon juice
10 twists of freshly ground black pepper
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: In a 2-cup liquid measuring cup or bowl, combine all of the ingredients as listed. Whisk until blended. Taste, and season with additional pepper if necessary.
This dressing is intentionally bold, but if it tastes too tart for your liking, whisk in another tablespoon of honey.
Store leftover salad dressing in the refrigerator, covered, for 10 to 14 days.

notes: Make it dairy free: If you have a favorite unsweetened dairy-free plain yogurt, it should work well here.
facts.summary: This creamy honey-mustard salad dressing recipe is lightened up with Greek yogurt. No mayo here! It’s so easy to whisk this dressing together. Recipe yields almost 1 ½ cups and keeps well for 10 to 14 days.
